data.camera: medium shot, walking through the school hallway with textbooks
data.description: 【黑川茜 · 阳东走廊】阳东高中的午后走廊，黑川茜抱着课本走过光斑交错的窗边，蓝紫直发在阳光里泛着清冷的光泽，制服裙摆随着步伐轻摆——「戏外的我，也只是一个普通的高中生而已。」
data.promptProse: Akane walks along the Yoto High School corridor with textbooks held against her white shirt and black sweater vest. Her gray pleated skirt shifts beneath the tie as blue-purple hair catches the light. The medium view follows alternating windows and doorways behind her. Afternoon daylight crosses the window bays onto her hair and book corners, placing a repeating pattern of brighter floor sections beneath her quiet steps.
data.title: 黑川茜 · 阳东走廊
